biggest_catch: Not available to US residents: Revolut's official help page lists Crypto Learn as supported only in the EEA, the UK, Switzerland, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and Brazil — the catalog's 'US resident' eligibility is wrong, so this route is unusable for the US audience.
catches: Official Revolut Help: 'Currently, Crypto Learn is supported in the EEA, the UK, Switzerland, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and Brazil.' — the US is excluded.
Reward amounts are shown in-app per lesson (denominated in fiat, e.g. '€5 of DOT') — there is no standing official '$2-$5 per course' figure; the catalog range is approximate at best.
Each lesson's reward can be earned only once; rewards are 'limited while funds last' — if a lesson's reward pool is exhausted, no reward is paid.
Revolut may change the reward amount or remove it completely (per official Crypto Terms).
Crypto value fluctuates between earning and any sale — crypto is never fixed income.

c1.evidence: Revolut is a real operating fintech (revolut.com); official Crypto Learn help page and official Crypto Terms (cdn.revolut.com) live.

c2.evidence: Official Revolut Crypto Terms: 'Crypto Learn & Earn is a programme offered by Revolut which allows you to learn about supported cryptoassets by completing short lessons, and earn crypto rewards.' Official help page documents access path and supported countries.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee — lessons and quizzes are free for Revolut customers.

c4.evidence: Official terms: 'Once completing a lesson, you may receive a small amount of cryptoasset as a reward.' The reward 'will be shown to you in the Revolut app before starting each lesson' — e.g. '€5 of DOT'.

eligibility: Revolut customer in a supported region: EEA, UK, Switzerland, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, or Brazil (official help page). Not available to US residents. Reward per lesson is claimable once; rewards limited while funds last.
notes: The program is real and ongoing — Revolut's current Crypto Terms (PDF updated 2026) describe Crypto Learn & Earn as a live program with regularly updated lessons — but the route is mis-targeted for a US audience: Revolut officially excludes the US. Corrected payout framing: Revolut publishes no standing per-course figure; the reward is shown in-app before each lesson (example given in official terms: '€5 of DOT'), claimable once per lesson, 'limited while funds last'. The app must show the in-app figure, not '$2-$5 per course', and must flag the region restriction prominently. Sources: help.revolut.com 'Crypto Learn' FAQ (crawled ~Aug 2026) and the official Revolut Cryptocurrency Terms PDF (cdn.revolut.com, version timestamped Nov 2025). No commits, no DB writes. payout_quote: Once completing a lesson, you may receive a small amount of cryptoasset as a reward. The reward you will receive for completing a lesson will be shown to you in the Revolut app before starting each lesson. The reward amount you will receive will be denominated in fiat currency (like GBP or EUR), but the reward will be in a cryptoasset token (for example '€5 of DOT').

steps: Open a Revolut account if you don't have one (only works in EEA, UK, Switzerland, Australia, NZ, Singapore, Brazil — not the US).
In the Revolut app, go to 'Crypto' on the bottom menu, select 'Discover', scroll to 'Learn', and tap 'See all' for the available courses.
Before starting a lesson, note the reward amount shown in-app (e.g. '€5 of DOT') — each lesson's reward can be earned only once.
Complete the lesson (short videos or cards) and answer the quiz questions.
The crypto reward is credited after completion; it can be held, sold, or transferred like other crypto in your Revolut account.
timing: Crypto reward credited after completing each lesson and its quiz; rewards limited while funds last.
